cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.

mechanism: A makes its former pupil apply precise witnessing standards before leaving a predicted impossible bell, then corrects clock error into a short further obligation.
confusable: Not stubbornly extending a failed prediction: B own clock correction makes the original deadline still pending.
comparison: Ambiguous prophecy date versus calculable remaining time.
seedUse: D146 bell-less tower/noon/fast watch/four minutes; S05 precise timing lessons.
